What you need
-------------

* An Amiga with a PowerPC card under WarpOS (WarpUP 5.x, powerpc.library), AmigaOS 3.0 or newer.
* An AGA or ECS screen in HiRes Laced (640x400, 16 colours), or a graphics card (Picasso96).
* About 1.5 MB of free memory, 250 KB of it chip RAM on a native screen; 4.5 MB more lets the
  program keep the whole pack in memory (PRELOAD).
* Sound through Paula (the default) or AHI (AUDIO=ahi).
* 64 KB of stack: give the icon a stack size of 65536, or type `Stack 65536` in the shell
  before starting it.
* The game's pack, built on a PC from your own copy of the game with the game's tools (its
  source's docs/game-data.md: `make data SRC=...` then `make pack`). Copy it into this drawer.

This build has not yet been run on a real machine or in an emulator; reports are welcome.
